verdict.rationale: Vercel documents choosing the region for its own object storage: each Blob store lives in one region you choose. Function execution regions are also configurable per project or per function. However, the same docs say the CDN caches files close to users, and there is no documented residency commitment covering other customer data such as logs, analytics, or build artifacts. Missing for 10: a platform-wide data residency guarantee (e.g., EU-only storage of all customer data), residency controls for logs/observability/deployment data, an explanation of how CDN caching interacts with residency, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Each store lives in one region that you choose, and Vercel's CDN caches your files close to your users.
You can override regions for individual functions using the functions property in your project configuration.
